The isomorphism-class recursion by adjoining an upper maximal point over an arbitrary ideal is mathematically exhaustive, and degree-refined full-permutation canonicalization is an exact isomorphism test. Two distinct exact enumerators agree for every class up to seven; 2045 classes at seven yield exactly six two-element collision fibers, with the complete certificate replayed. 2045 full bivariate vectors are separately distinct. Neither a finite sample beyond its finite domain nor a hypothetical infinite extension is claimed.

value.rationale: The natural rank of the possible-below singleton-type lattice compresses two named predecessor/successor cardinalities into one graded logical invariant. The exact reconstruction boundary at seven, six explicitly classified failures among every small poset isomorphism class, and comparison with the stronger bivariate seven-point injection identify a sharp and mathematically motivated information-loss threshold. This finite classification is not a routine sign check, arbitrary parameter slice or recomputation of a known table; no broader theorem is asserted or needed.
